IS 269.issuing_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
IS 269.statutory_provisions: Section 16 & Section 29 of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016.
IS 269.penalties_and_consequences: Any person who manufactures, imports, sells, distributes, or stores cement without a valid BIS ISI Certification Mark is liable for imprisonment up to two years or a minimum fine of ₹2,00,000 or both, along with confiscation of goods.
IS 269.exemption_policy: No general commercial exemptions. All imported and domestic production must hold valid BIS Standard Mark.

IS 1489 (Part 1).issuing_ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
IS 1489 (Part 1).penalties_and_consequences: Mandatory BIS license required for manufacturing and distribution. Strict penal provisions under BIS Act 2016.

IS 1489 (Part 2).issuing_ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
IS 1489 (Part 2).penalties_and_consequences: Strict compliance required. ISI mark mandatory on all packaging bags.

IS 455.issuing_ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
IS 455.penalties_and_consequences: Mandatory ISI mark. Non-compliant stock subject to seizure and criminal prosecution.

IS 1786.qco_name: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order
IS 1786.issuing_ministry: Ministry of Steel, Government of India
IS 1786.statutory_provisions: Section 16 of the BIS Act, 2016 read with Ministry of Steel mandates.
IS 1786.penalties_and_consequences: Total ban on non-ISI certified rebar/TMT production, rolling, stocking, and supply. Heavy fines and legal prosecution under Section 29.
IS 1786.exemption_policy: Exemptions only granted on specific non-substitutable capital equipment steel by Ministry of Steel Technical Committee.

IS 456.certification_scheme: National Code of Practice (Statutory via NBC & Municipal Bylaws)
IS 456.qco_name: National Building Code (NBC) / State Municipal By-Laws Mandate
IS 456.issuing_ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) / State Urban Local Bodies
IS 456.legal_status: MANDATORY CODE OF PRACTICE IN BUILDING BY-LAWS
IS 456.statutory_provisions: State Municipal Corporation Acts & Structural Safety Bylaws.
IS 456.penalties_and_consequences: Structural engineers and contractors are liable for structural failure, criminal negligence, and cancellation of license if design departs from IS 456 without peer-reviewed sanction.
IS 456.exemption_policy: Special structures with international peer review.

IS 1343.certification_scheme: Code of Practice (Statutory for PSC Infrastructure Projects)
IS 1343.qco_name: MoRTH / NHAI / Indian Railways Concrete Bridge Standards
IS 1343.issuing_ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) & Ministry of Railways
IS 1343.statutory_provisions: Indian Highways & Railways Statutory Quality Specifications.
IS 1343.penalties_and_consequences: Rejection of PSC girders and debarment from government contracts for non-compliance.

IS 4926.certification_scheme: Scheme-I (Ready-Mixed Concrete Plant Certification Scheme - RMCPCS)
IS 4926.qco_name: Quality Control Criteria for Ready Mixed Concrete Plants
IS 4926.legal_status: MANDATORY IN CPWD / METRO RAIL / SMART CITIES TENDERS
IS 4926.penalties_and_consequences: Ineligibility to supply concrete for public infrastructure projects without valid RMCPCS certification.
IS 4926.exemption_policy: Site-specific captive batching plants with approved QA manuals.

IS 383.certification_scheme: Voluntary Product Certification / Mandatory in Public Works Specifications
IS 383.qco_name: CPWD & State PWD Standard Specifications for Aggregates
IS 383.legal_status: MANDATORY UNDER CPWD & NHAI PROCUREMENT SPECIFICATIONS
IS 383.statutory_provisions: Mandatory testing protocol prior to concrete mix acceptance.
IS 383.penalties_and_consequences: Rejection of aggregate quarry source and quarry supply bans on failure of 5-cycle soundness or alkali-reactivity tests.
